title: Are you using Live Artifacts?
description:
Most people still don’t understand
how important Live Artifacts in Claude really are 👀

Because AI is no longer just about generating things.

Now you can build live dashboards ⚡

Connected to:
– Airtable
– ClickUp
– databases
– internal systems

And they update automatically 🤯

No manual updates
No rebuilding reports
No moving information around all day

This is where AI starts becoming
a REAL operational layer for businesses 🚀
